objectives.label: Inspect the toll gate and collect its takings

grant.name: The toll takings
grant.lore: Counted and sealed for the lord of {settlement}

title: The toll gate's takings
Count the tolls
The keeper's books
summary: Inspect the toll gate of the domain, {distance} {direction} of {settlement}, and bring its takings back sealed.
His lordship wants the toll counted and the takings brought home. Go to the gate, {direction} of here.
Ride to the toll gate, look at the keeper's books, and carry back the takings.
offer: The tollkeeper swears trade is thin. Perhaps. Go and look, {distance} {direction}, and bring back what is there.
Count the gate's tolls for me and bring them back, sealed. Watch the keeper's face while you count.
His lordship's toll gate, {direction} of here. Its takings belong in the treasury, not the keeper's purse.
progress: Have you been to the toll gate?
What did the keeper's books say?
complete: The takings, sealed. And the keeper's books? Good enough. Thank you.
Counted and home. His lordship will be pleased.
All there. The keeper is honest, or careful.
